summary.tagline: Muckross Lake (Irish: Loch Mhucrois), also called Middle Lake or The Torc, is a lake in Killarney National Par

days.title: East Shore and Muckross Estate
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Muckross House and Gardens
stops.detail: It is integrated into the elaborately designed historical complex Muckross House and Gardens on the eastern shore of the lake.

stops.name: Muckross Peninsula
stops.detail: This "Muckross Peninsula" consists partly of boggy terrain – a small lake, the Doo Lough (Irish An Dúloch), is also located here – but it is possible to walk around the lake on well-developed and maintained paths.

days.title: Waterfalls and Southern Currents
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Old Weir Bridge
stops.detail: In the lower reaches, the confluence of the river water with that of Lough Leane and Muckross Lake near the Old Weir Bridge results in a natural spectacle called The Meeting of the Waters, which is characterized by a strong current.

stops.name: Torc Waterfall
stops.detail: A river fed by a mountain lake called "The Devil's Punchbowl" (Irish Poll Ifrinn, "Hell's Hole") on the southern Mangerton Mountain, the Torc River, flows via the Torc Waterfall on the southeastern shore into Muckross Lake.
